shared_policy.entry_and_direction: 252-session IV-spread rank, minimum 63 observations; bottom 20% long first leg, top 20% short first leg
shared_policy.features: The identical 27 directional fields and definitions in scripts.tail_put25_pooled.FEATURES, mapped by scripts.same_structure_smile.oriented_states
shared_policy.profitability_gate: Both 91-day and 365-day completed directional profits positive, with at least 21 and 63 observations respectively
shared_policy.optional_features: Neutral fill plus availability flag; missing optional inputs do not veto an entry
shared_policy.training: Independent pooled wing policies, five years of finite completed outcomes, monthly refits, eight-leaf tree and direct-Sharpe policy search
shared_policy.cold_start: Common global full-size fallback below 16 pooled rows
shared_policy.risk_reservations: Same $1m/20k gross vega per pair-wing and $3m/60k per pair, shared cash and net stock hedges
shared_policy.holding_policy: Each leg to its own expiry, with audited corporate exits

ladder_policy: Each ladder is applied to all three wings unchanged; no mixture of a different winning ladder per wing

original_calendar_coverage_control.selection: Original rule action-date index for each pair, applied equally to all wings; original action values and allocations are ignored

interpretation: The identical structure retains approximately 0.8 Sharpe in 25-delta puts on original coverage, but does not recover 0.8 for the combined portfolio. ATM and 75-delta puts have weaker signals under these shared rules. Broader-calendar results remain poor.
evidence_limit: Previously inspected data, no new holdout; all paired 95% block-bootstrap intervals for sizing uplift include zero
archived_0_778: Preserved heterogeneous checkpoint; it is not an identical-structure result
